collection.description: The complete Timaeus, Plato's account of the making of the world, which opens with Critias' story of Atlantis (20d-25d). Every Stephanus section is shown on the page of the oldest medieval manuscript that carries it, Paris gr. 1807 (9th century), with Burnet's Greek and R. G. Bury's English.
